meta.title: Keyfly – Move in without a deposit
meta.description: Keyfly replaces the rental deposit: you pay a small monthly fee and your landlord receives insurance cover instead. Join the waitlist.

comingSoon.lead: Keyfly replaces the rental deposit. Instead of setting aside hundreds of thousands of forints up front, you pay a small monthly fee, and your landlord receives insurance cover in its place.

example.label: WORKED EXAMPLE
example.disclaimer: Illustrative example. Your fee is set by individual assessment and shown in your offer.

audience.title: It pays off for both sides.
audience.lead: Keyfly gives tenants financial headroom and landlords insurance cover. The same security, with less money tied up.

items.upfront: No need to set aside several months' rent at once.
items.savings: Instead of a deposit you pay a small monthly fee, and your savings stay available to you.
items.online: You get your offer online in a few minutes and see the exact fee before you accept.

items.cover: You're covered up to the deposit amount, and the insurer pays out on a valid claim.
items.admin: No deposit to hold or settle, and you can report a claim online.
items.free: It's free for you, and you can choose from a wider pool of reliable tenants.

steps.title: An offer in a few minutes.
steps.durationText: Roughly how long it takes to request an offer. No paperwork, no branch visit, right from your phone.

details.title: Your rental details
details.text: Enter the rent, the deposit amount and your planned move-in date.

income.title: Income check
income.text: Through a secure bank connection, on your own bank's site. No documents to collect.

offer.title: Instant offer
offer.text: See your cover and monthly fee right away. Once you accept, your landlord receives the insurer's certificate of cover.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Write to us and we'll reply within one working day.

launch.a: We're preparing for launch and will announce the date once every condition is confirmed. People on the waitlist hear first.

cost.a: The fee depends on the deposit amount and an individual assessment. With {rent} rent and a three-month deposit, it's roughly {fee} a month. You see the exact fee in your offer before you accept.

refund.q: Is the fee refunded like a deposit?
refund.a: No. The fee is the price of the service, not a deposit. In return, the full deposit amount stays with you and is yours to use.

claim.q: What happens if the landlord suffers a loss?
claim.a: On a valid claim, the insurer compensates the landlord and then recovers the amount from you. Keyfly replaces paying a deposit, not your responsibility as a tenant.

landlord.q: What does the landlord need to do?
landlord.a: Simply accept the insurer's certificate of cover instead of a deposit. The service is free for them.
